cat > /home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-00074864.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Each connected frame encloses a rectangle. Fill its interior: 7 when both
    # interior dimensions are odd, otherwise 2.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            color = grid[sr][sc]
            if color == bg or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(sr, sc)]; seen.add((sr, sc)); cells = []
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop(); cells.append((r,c))
                for rr, cc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color and (rr,cc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((rr,cc)); stack.append((rr,cc))
            r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
            c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # Require a complete rectangular perimeter for this component.
            if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                    all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
                continue
            interior=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
            if not interior or not all(grid[r][c] == bg for r,c in interior):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0-1)%2 and (c1-c0-1)%2 else 2
            for r,c in interior: out[r][c]=fill
    return out
PY
